description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Vice President of Public Policy, the Head of Government Affairs will develop and execute government relations strategies that enable market expansion, protect existing operations, and advance favorable legislative and regulatory frameworks for autonomous delivery. This position will build relationships with policymakers and key stakeholders, manage regulatory and political risks, and lead advocacy initiatives across domestic and international markets. The role will work cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Legal, and Communications to align government affairs initiatives with broader business objectives.

JOB DUTIES

  • Develop and execute government affairs strategies that support market expansion, protect existing operations, and advance the company’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain relationships with elected officials, regulatory agencies, and other government stakeholders across domestic and international markets.

  • Lead legislative and regulatory advocacy efforts, including securing operational approvals, influencing policy development, and mitigating regulatory risks.

  • Monitor, analyze, and interpret legislative, regulatory, and political developments, providing actionable recommendations to internal stakeholders.

  • Manage external lobbyists, consultants, and trade association relationships to advance government affairs priorities and maximize the effectiveness of resources.

  • Collaborate with Operations, Product, Legal, and Communications teams to align business initiatives with regulatory requirements and government affairs strategies.

  • Build and mobilize coalitions of industry partners, nonprofit organizations, community stakeholders, and other third parties to advance policy objectives.

  • Develop advocacy materials, policy positions, legislative proposals, and briefing documents, and represent the company before legislative and regulatory bodies.

  • Manage and develop Government Affairs and Public Policy team members, establish strategic priorities and performance objectives, and communicate progress and outcomes to senior leadership.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

  • 8+ years of experience in government affairs, government relations, public policy, political organizing, legislative staffing, public affairs, or a related field.

  • Bachelor’s degree.

  • Demonstrated success in developing and executing government affairs and legislative advocacy strategies, including working with policymakers across political parties.

  • Strong understanding of legislative and regulatory processes at the state and local levels.

  • Experience selecting, onboarding, and managing external lobbyists and government affairs consultants.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interpret legislation, develop policy recommendations, and communicate complex issues to internal and external audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to build effective stakeholder relationships, manage competing priorities, and work collaboratively across business functions.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Advanced degree in law, public policy, public administration, urban planning, or a related discipline.

  • Experience in technology, autonomous systems, transportation, mobility, or other emerging and highly regulated industries.

  • Established network of policymakers, government affairs professionals, and contract lobbyists across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience managing and developing government affairs or public policy teams, including geographically distributed team members.

  • Experience building and mobilizing coalitions to advance legislative and regulatory objectives.

  • Experience supporting international market expansion or navigating regulatory frameworks outside the United States.

  • Experience establishing performance metrics and communicating the business impact of government affairs initiatives to senior leadership.

  • Experience developing formal government submissions, including RFPs, RFIs, regulatory comments, and legislative testimony.

  • Experience representing an organization at public hearings, conferences, and other external engagements.

Additional Information

  • This position requires travel of up to 50%, including domestic and international travel. Occasional work outside standard business hours may be necessary to accommodate legislative schedules, public meetings, and stakeholder engagements.
